Format

[edit]
  • Week 6 matches will be played with default map.
  • Rest of the matches will be played with Annual Map Change
  • Map changes will randomly be implemented every game.
    • September 2026 – Present
      • Revealing Wisps - Collectible wisps briefly circle their collector and automatically fly toward and reveal nearby enemies.
      • Healing Turtle - The Turtle follows the minion waves toward the enemy's strongest lane and heals nearby allies.
      • Golden Turret - Destroying turrets now grants significantly more gold to the entire team.
      • Flying Cloud - Near-base platforms let respawned heroes hover for 5 seconds, quickly reaching high ground.
    • September 2025 – September 2026
      • Dangerous Grass - Dense bushes now cover key areas like Mid, Lord's pit, and turrets.
      • Broken Walls - New wall gaps open shortcuts across the map.
      • Flying Cloud - Near-base platforms let respawned heroes hover for 5 seconds, quickly reaching high ground.
      • Expanding Rivers - The river now spills into nearby lanes, boosting movement speed.
  • Regular Season: August 14th - October 18th, 2026
    • Double Round Robin
    • All matches are Bo3.
      • Earn 1 points for winning
      • No point for losing
    • Top 6 teams will advance to the Playoffs.
